dialogue.speaker: purple
dialogue.text: The house is a complete mess. Because you work from home, can't you clean up around the house a little bit? I'm so exhausted… I'm tired of cleaning up after you all the time.

dialogue.speaker: orange
dialogue.text: Do you know how hard I've been working? I take care of all the bills while you go and stick your head in a book.

dialogue.speaker: purple
dialogue.text: Why are you getting so angry? Just because I'm still in college doesn't mean I don't do anything to help. I still work part-time.

dialogue.speaker: orange
dialogue.text: Sure… like the pennies you earn contribute anything. But it's fine… Instead of focusing on my career, I'll just spend all my time scrubbing dishes and picking up trash.

dialogue.speaker: orange
dialogue.text: I'm just stressed. I wish there was less on my plate. It's hard being the only one who actually earns. Everything is a mess right now, I wish I could help around the house, but I just don't have it in me :(

choices.text: I'm trying my best too. I'm tired with my schedule. I'm either studying or doing chores or at work, every hour I get.
Maybe if I pick up some more shifts, it'll take some pressure off you. Then you can use the extra time to help me around the house, so our work is distributed more equally.
